title: Engineering Materials with BME applications
description: Materials for engineering focused on biomaterials and biomedical applications; atomic structure for biomaterials including metals, ceramics, polymers, and composites; crystalline structures; mechanical properties of metals, ceramics, and polymers, and their application as biomaterials; properties of semiconductors; electrical & optical properties of polymers, ceramics, and metal; applications of polymers as biomaterials in tissue engineering and drug delivery systems.
notes: Not open for credit to students registered in or with credit in MECH 285.
